settings.repere: Intertitre · is cat years clinically proven?
Intertitre · Yes. In a study led by a University De…
settings.text: Yes. In a study led by a University Department of Animal Biosciences, one cat years hydration booster per day drove a statistically significant increase in hydration. This is based on two key hydration biomarkers – increase in total water intake and decrease in urine specific gravity (i.e., urine concentration) (Kosmal et al., 2026).
